accelBuiltinBody:
1. The built-in channel is deployed and maintained by the app developer solely to accelerate GitHub Release asset downloads. It serves no other purpose.
2. No credentials required: Requests via the built-in channel do not include your GitHub access token. The channel is not involved in your login and does not access your repository data.
3. Encrypted transmission: The built-in channel uses HTTPS (TLS) encryption. To facilitate acceleration, the target asset URL is known to the channel; it does not retain long-term copies of your downloaded files.
4. Availability: Service interruptions may occur due to maintenance, rate limiting, network failures, or force majeure. During outages, Release assets remain available via direct connection, ensuring functionality is not impacted.
5. No absolute guarantees: This statement accurately describes the channel's technical characteristics but does not guarantee "absolute availability" or "absolute security." If you have concerns, use a direct connection or add a trusted custom channel.
6. You can disable the channel at any time to stop using it. This declaration takes effect on your usage from the moment you agree.
accelBuiltinStatement:
Built-in Channel Safety Statement

1. The built-in channel is **deployed and maintained by the app developer** exclusively to accelerate the download of GitHub Release assets. It serves no other purpose.

2. **No credential acceptance**: When using the built-in channel, your GitHub access token is not included in requests. The channel does not participate in your login process or read your repository data.

3. **Encrypted transmission**: The built-in channel uses HTTPS (TLS) encryption. To complete acceleration, the target asset download URL becomes known to the channel; however, the channel does not retain long-term copies of the files you download.

4. **Availability**: The channel may be interrupted due to maintenance, rate limiting, network failures, or force majeure. During interruptions, Release assets can still be downloaded via **direct connection**, ensuring functionality remains unaffected.

5. **No absolute guarantees**: This statement provides an honest description of the channel's technical characteristics and does not guarantee "absolute availability" or "absolute security." If you have concerns, please use direct connections or add a trusted custom channel.

6. You can disable the master switch at any time to stop using this channel. This statement takes effect regarding your usage behavior from the moment you check the agreement box.
accelThirdPartyBody:

Its operator, availability, bandwidth, stability, content integrity, and security are solely the responsibility of the third party. The app provides no warranties of any kind.
2. Once enabled, your Release asset download requests (including the target URL) will be sent to the third-party server. You must verify that you trust the service provider and independently assess the privacy, data, and compliance risks involved.
3. The app is not liable for download failures, data corruption, content tampering, privacy leaks, extra fees, or any direct/indirect losses resulting from the use of this third-party service.
4. You are responsible for verifying and complying with the laws, regulations, and internal policies regarding network access and data transfer in your country/region and organization.
5. You can terminate usage at any time by toggling the master switch off or removing the channel. After deactivation, Release assets will revert to direct downloads.
6. By checking the box, you confirm that you have fully read, understood, and voluntarily accepted all of the above.
accelThirdPartyDisclaimer:

This app makes no warranties of any kind.

2. Once enabled, your Release asset download requests (including target download URLs) will be sent to the third party's servers. Please ensure you trust the service provider and independently assess any resulting privacy, data, and compliance risks.

accelUrlCjk: The URL must not contain Chinese or full-width characters.
accelUrlPlainHttp: Plain http:// is blocked on Android 9+. Please use https://
accelUrlPlaintext: Plain http:// is blocked on Android 9+. Please use https://
accelUrlScheme: URL must start with https:// or http://
accelUrlSpace: The URL must not contain spaces.
pathBackslash: Please use / as the path separator, not \
pathCharset: Names can only contain English letters, digits, and . _ - (no special characters).
pathCjk: Paths must not contain Chinese or full-width characters (please use English).
pathControl: Paths must not contain control characters.
pathDirNeedSlash: When creating a directory, the path must end with / (e.g., docs/api/).
pathDoubleSlash: Paths must not contain consecutive slashes (//).
pathEmptyContent: File content cannot be empty (please enter at least one line).
pathFileNoSlash: When creating a file, the path must not end with /.
pathReqDir: Please enter a directory path (e.g., docs/api/).
pathReqFile: Please enter a file path (e.g., src/main.dart).
pathReserved: "{name}" is a reserved Windows name and cannot be created.
pathSegTooLong: Individual segment names cannot exceed {max} characters (current: {count}).
pathSegTrailing: Names must not end with a dot or space (cannot be created on Windows).
pathTooLong: Each path segment cannot exceed 100 characters (currently {length}).
readmeTruncated: The _README_ is too long and has been truncated. The original content is more complete.
